title: MecHand user levels
description: What each user level (A student, B advanced student, C researcher) can use. Edit levels.json; VS Code checks it against this schema as you type.

default.description: Level used until the user chooses one (also when ?level= is not given).

A.description: Student: secondary school and first years of a degree.

B.description: Advanced student: end of the degree, master's, start of a PhD.

basicTemplates.description: Template ids offered when a level has "templates": "basic". Structure ids are those of src/templates/library.json; mechanisms are "mech-<id>" (src/templates/index.json). `npm run check:content` reports unknown ids.

templates.description: "basic": only the ids in basicTemplates. "all": the whole library.

learnHelp.description: Chemistry explanations (why each arrow, lone pairs, octet, nucleophiles…). "on": shown from the start. "available": the user can turn them on in Help. "off": hidden.

periodicTable.description: The simple periodic table button in the MecHand bar.

onlineLookup.description: Look names and CAS numbers up on PubChem/OPSIN from the library.

teach.description: The Teach dialog (train the recognizer on one's handwriting).

recognitionServer.description: The optional DECIMER recognition server (About panel).

helpDetail.description: Default detail of the button help labels: "student" (longer) or "brief".

export.description: Export formats offered, in this order.
